poses:
Create a production-quality 2D fighting game full-body raster sprite atlas of JUDAS from Tales of Destiny 2, using the attached sheet as design reference. Preserve his slim youthful male proportions, dark purple-black short hair, bone ivory skull/dragon mask with two elegant pointed horns and a pale cyan ribbon/plume trailing behind, stern visible eye, black/purple fitted armor with silver piping, huge flowing black cape with purple lining, dark boots. Two separate blades: right hand shorter sword, left longer silver sword. Beautiful sharp anime cel shading, clean readable silhouette, as detailed as or better than reference. NOT chibi. Transparent background. No text/numbers/grid/borders/effects/enemies/afterimages. Exactly 24 isolated full-body sprites, uniform 6 columns x 4 rows on 1536x1024 canvas, each confined to own 256x256 cell with 12px clear gutters. Show complete mask horns, plume, hands, blade tips and boots, no clipping. Body scales consistent across all cells; feet share baseline within cells. All side poses face RIGHT; rear attack pose still body facing right but blades reach LEFT.
Row1: 0 neutral three-quarter idle standing with both blades low; 1 walking step; 2 running leaning with cape streaming left; 3 crouching low both blades ready; 4 standing turn with cape opening; 5 airborne descending knees bent blades out.
Row2: 6 jab short right blade horizontal slash at chest; 7 jab2 left long blade diagonal slash; 8 up tilt one sword raised overhead with bent elbow; 9 jab3 both blades crossed low-to-high; 10 neutral air body twisted legs splayed double circular slash pose; 11 down tilt deep low crouch sword sweep at ankle height.
Row3: 12 forward smash broad forward lunging double blade cleave; 13 up smash elevated spring uppercut both blades above mask; 14 back air twisting backward with sword thrust LEFT; 15 dash attack very low fast passing slash; 16 down air suspended above with both blades pointing down; 17 grab right hand extended open and left blade held safely back.
Row4: 18 pummel short hilt blow; 19 forward throw pushing forward both boots grounded; 20 shield crossed blades guarding chest; 21 damage recoil head back; 22 downed lying on side full figure; 23 victory quietly lowering both blades. Every one of 15 attack sprites has visibly distinct limb arrangement and blade line. No drawn magic/slash glows embedded into character art.

portrait: Create a dedicated high-resolution character selection portrait of JUDAS (ジューダス) from Tales of Destiny 2. Image1 is design reference; image2 approved game character. Faithful slender youthful male, short purple-black hair and stern eye visible beneath an ornate bone-ivory dragon skull mask, TWO tall elegant horns, purple-black fitted armor with silver ornamental piping, black cape rich dark-purple lining, pale cyan plume/ribbon extending back left. Beautiful polished anime painting with intricate clean linework and rich cel shadows, at least reference quality. REAL transparent RGBA 1536x1024 landscape, absolutely no background, haze, magic, logo or text. CLOSE HEAD AND SHOULDERS, centered face three-quarter facing slightly right toward viewer. Face and mask large, cheek-to-chin not tiny; mask with eye area occupies central image. Highest horn around y80 with 80px transparent TOP margin so neither horn nor cyan plume clips; chin around y760. Shoulders fill bottom and run beyond bottom edge. Both sides of mask and face fully visible. Keep helmet's skull design identical to reference, NOT a generic knight helmet. Plume can flow into left of canvas but stays entirely in canvas. No swords/hands crossing the face, no full body. Dedicated portrait composition, do not enlarge a small sprite.
portraitFraming: Precise framing repair of the attached JUDAS character selection portrait, an EDIT TARGET. Preserve EXACT SAME large face, eye, expression, skull mask lower face, costume, black-purple cape, silver piping, and cel illustration details. Both tall horn tips are CUT OFF at top. Reshape ONLY the upper ivory skull mask HORNS to SHORTER elegant pointed bone horns, matching character design. Both HIGHEST tips must end below y80 on the same1536x1024 canvas, leaving 80px of completely empty transparent space across TOP EDGE. Keep face size and eye center unchanged, do not zoom out or make shoulders smaller. Keep cyan ribbon completely within canvas with no glow outside it. Pure transparent alpha background, no new background or haze. All horn tips complete and pointed. Do not alter anything else.
